events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.
I'll build this as a single canvas-rendered scene with procedural ramen, steam and lighting, then write it to `index.html`.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#050302;overflow:hidden}
canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen glowing warmly in a dark room"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
'use strict';

const TAU = Math.PI * 2, PI = Math.PI;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const smooth = (a, b, x) => { const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
const mulberry = (s) => () => {
  s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
  let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
  t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
  return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};
const rand = mulberry(90210);
const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * rand();

const cv = document.getElementById('scene');
const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let reduced = mq.matches;

/* ---------- pre-rendered sprites ---------- */
function makePuff() {
  const s = 128, c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = s;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const a = rand() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rand()) * s * 0.24;
    const x = s / 2 + Math.cos(a) * d, y = s / 2 + Math.sin(a) * d, r = s * rr(0.14, 0.3);
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,242,224,0.30)');
    gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,242,224,0)');
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);
  }
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
  const m = g.createRadialGradient(s / 2, s / 2, 0, s / 2, s / 2, s / 2);
  m.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
  m.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
  m.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.fillStyle = m;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);
  return c;
}
const puffs = [makePuff(), makePuff(), makePuff()];

const glowSprite = (() => {
  const s = 32, c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = s;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  const gr = g.createRadialGradient(s / 2, s / 2, 0, s / 2, s / 2, s / 2);
  gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,214,150,1)');
  gr.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(255,170,90,0.45)');
  gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,140,60,0)');
  g.fillStyle = gr;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);
  return c;
})();

const grain = (() => {
  const s = 180, c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = s;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  const id = g.createImageData(s, s);
  for (let i = 0; i < id.data.length; i += 4) {
    const v = rand() * 255;
    id.data[i] = id.data[i + 1] = id.data[i + 2] = v;
    id.data[i + 3] = 255;
  }
  g.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
  return c;
})();
const grainPattern = ctx.createPattern(grain, 'repeat');

/* ---------- static scene data ---------- */
const NS = 24, NP = 120, NC = 10, CL = NP / NC;
const strands = Array.from({ length: NS }, () => ({
  th0: rand() * TAU, dir: rand() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1, turns: rr(0.9, 1.7),
  r0: rr(0.10, 0.48), r1: rr(0.10, 0.5), ph: rand() * TAU,
  wf: rr(60, 95), wa: rr(0.016, 0.028), hy: rr(0.8, 1.15),
  w: rr(2.5, 3.1), tone: rr(-10, 10), zoff: rr(-0.01, 0.03)
}));
const PX = strands.map(() => new Float32Array(NP + 1));
const PY = strands.map(() => new Float32Array(NP + 1));
const PZ = strands.map(() => new Float32Array(NP + 1));
const PV = strands.map(() => new Float32Array(NP + 1));
const chunks = [];
for (let s = 0; s < NS; s++) for (let c = 0; c < NC; c++) chunks.push({ s, c, key: 0, z: 0 });

const EXCL = [
  [-0.66, -0.24, 0.30], [0.55, 0.30, 0.20], [0.30, 0.50, 0.18], [-0.50, 0.42, 0.28],
  [-0.16, 0.60, 0.14], [0.52, -0.52, 0.24], [-0.26, -0.62, 0.20]
];
function freeSpot(maxR) {
  for (let t = 0; t < 30; t++) {
    const r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * maxR, a = rand() * TAU;
    const u = Math.cos(a) * r, v = Math.sin(a) * r;
    let ok = true;
    for (const e of EXCL) if (Math.hypot(u - e[0], v - e[1]) < e[2]) { ok = false; break; }
    if (ok) return [u, v];
  }
  return [0, 0.1];
}

const oil = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
  const chili = rand() < 0.35, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.86, a = rand() * TAU;
  oil.push({
    u: Math.cos(a) * r, v: Math.sin(a) * r, chili, ph: rand() * TAU,
    s: chili ? rr(0.016, 0.045) : rr(0.012, 0.07),
    vx: rr(-0.006, 0.006), vy: rr(-0.005, 0.005)
  });
}

const scallions = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 54; i++) {
  const p = freeSpot(0.88);
  scallions.push({ u: p[0], v: p[1], s: rr(0.026, 0.044), ring: rand() < 0.68, a: rand() * TAU });
}
scallions.sort((a, b) => a.v - b.v);

const sesame = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
  const p = freeSpot(0.9);
  sesame.push({ u: p[0], v: p[1], a: rand() * TAU });
}

const corn = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
  const a = rand() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.13;
  corn.push({ u: -0.16 + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.3, v: 0.60 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.6, a: rand() * TAU });
}
corn.sort((a, b) => a.v - b.v);

const noriTop = Array.from({ length: 9 }, () => rr(-0.04, 0.04));
const noriFibers = Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => [rand(), rr(-0.02, 0.02)]);

/* ---------- dynamic state ---------- */
let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, R = 100, q = 1, cx = 0, cy = 0;
let k = 0.35, ry = 0, D = 0, Rb = 0, by = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
let time = 0, flick = 1;
const ptr = { x: 0, y: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, last: -1e9, live: false };
const light = { x: 0, y: 0 };
const steam = [], motes = [], ripples = [];
let spawnAcc = 0, ambientRipple = 1.5, moveRipple = 0;

function S(u, v, z) { return [u * Rb, by + v * Rb * k - z * R]; }
function zMound(u, v) {
  const d = Math.min(1, Math.hypot((u - 0.02) / 1.06, (v + 0.03) / 0.96) / 0.72);
  return 0.24 * (1 - d * d) * 0.95;
}
function ell(x, y, rx, ryy, rot) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(rx, 0.01), Math.max(ryy, 0.01), rot || 0, 0, TAU);
}
function rrect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function flatRect(x, y, w, h, ang, r) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.scale(1, k); ctx.rotate(ang);
  ctx.beginPath();
  rrect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h, r);
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- layout ---------- */
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  cv.width = Math.round(W * dpr); cv.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
  R = Math.min(W * 0.40, H * 0.35);
  q = R / 100;
  cx = W / 2; cy = H * 0.5 + R * 0.42;
  if (!ptr.live && ptr.sx === 0) { ptr.sx = W * 0.5; ptr.sy = H * 0.3; }
  light.x = ptr.sx; light.y = ptr.sy;
  geometry();
  motes.length = 0;
  const n = clamp(Math.round(W * H / 24000), 28, 80);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    motes.push({
      x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, vx: 0, s: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.4,
      sp: 0.6 + Math.random(), ph: Math.random() * TAU, tw: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.6
    });
  }
  steam.length = 0;
  prefillSteam();
}

function geometry() {
  const ny = clamp(light.y / H, 0, 1) - 0.5, nx = clamp(light.x / W, 0, 1) - 0.5;
  ox = -nx * R * 0.06; oy = -ny * R * 0.035;
  k = 0.35 + ny * 0.07;
  ry = R * k; D = R * 0.62; Rb = R * 0.905; by = ry * 0.16;
}

/* ---------- simulation ---------- */
function updatePointer(dt) {
  const now = performance.now();
  ptr.live = now - ptr.last < 6000;
  let tx = ptr.x, ty = ptr.y;
  if (!ptr.live) {
    tx = W * (0.5 + 0.30 * Math.sin(time * 0.11));
    ty = H * (0.30 + 0.07 * Math.sin(time * 0.083 + 1.3));
  }
  const px = ptr.sx, py = ptr.sy;
  if (reduced) {
    ptr.sx = tx; ptr.sy = ty; ptr.vx = ptr.vy = 0;
  } else {
    const a = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * (ptr.live ? 5 : 0.9));
    ptr.sx += (tx - ptr.sx) * a; ptr.sy += (ty - ptr.sy) * a;
    if (dt > 0) {
      ptr.vx += (clamp((ptr.sx - px) / dt, -1500, 1500) - ptr.vx) * 0.25;
      ptr.vy += (clamp((ptr.sy - py) / dt, -1500, 1500) - ptr.vy) * 0.25;
    }
  }
  light.x = ptr.sx; light.y = ptr.sy;
}

function spawnSteam() {
  const sc = R / 300, a = Math.random() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.7;
  const x = cx + ox + Math.cos(a) * r * Rb * 0.85;
  const y = cy + oy + by + Math.sin(a) * r * Rb * k - R * 0.12 - Math.random() * R * 0.1;
  steam.push({
    x, y, y0: y, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10, vy: -20 * sc, age: 0,
    life: 5 + Math.random() * 3.5, s0: R * (0.10 + Math.random() * 0.06),
    s1: R * (0.34 + Math.random() * 0.26), rot: Math.random() * TAU,
    vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, a: 0.07 + Math.random() * 0.05,
    seed: Math.random(), sp: Math.random(), img: (Math.random() * 3) | 0
  });
}

function stepSteam(dt) {
  const sc = R / 300;
  spawnAcc += dt * 26;
  while (spawnAcc >= 1) { spawnAcc -= 1; spawnSteam(); }
  const wind = ptr.live && !reduced;
  for (let i = steam.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = steam[i];
    p.age += dt;
    if (p.age >= p.life) { steam.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    const f = p.age / p.life, h = (p.y0 - p.y) / R;
    const targetVy = -(38 + p.sp * 30) * sc * (1 - 0.35 * f);
    p.vy += (targetVy - p.vy) * Math.min(1, dt * 0.9);
    const sw = Math.sin(p.y * 0.012 + time * 0.75 + p.seed * TAU) + 0.6 * Math.sin(p.x * 0.009 - time * 0.5 + p.seed * 9);
    p.vx += sw * 26 * sc * dt * (0.3 + Math.max(0, h) * 1.6);
    if (wind) {
      const dx = p.x - ptr.sx, dy = p.y - ptr.sy, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 0.001, inf = R * 0.55;
      if (d < inf) {
        const w = 1 - d / inf, w2 = w * w;
        p.vx += (dx / d) * 160 * sc * w2 * dt + (ptr.vx * 0.6 - p.vx) * w2 * dt * 5;
        p.vy += (dy / d) * 90 * sc * w2 * dt + (ptr.vy * 0.4 - p.vy) * w2 * dt * 3;
      }
    }
    p.vx *= Math.exp(-0.7 * dt);
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.rot += p.vr * dt;
  }
}

function prefillSteam() {
  const t0 = time;
  for (let i = 0; i < 270; i++) { time += 1 / 30; stepSteam(1 / 30); }
  time = reduced ? 12 : t0;
}

function stepMotes(dt) {
  const sc = R / 300, wind = ptr.live && !reduced;
  for (const m of motes) {
    m.y -= (6 + m.s * 6) * m.sp * dt * sc;
    m.x += (Math.sin(time * 0.3 + m.ph) * 6 + m.vx) * dt;
    if (wind) {
      const dx = m.x - ptr.sx, dy = m.y - ptr.sy, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 0.001, inf = R * 0.5;
      if (d < inf) { const w = 1 - d / inf; m.vx += ((dx / d) * 60 + ptr.vx * 0.3) * w * w * dt * 4; }
    }
    m.vx *= Math.exp(-0.8 * dt);
    if (m.y < -10) { m.y = H + 10; m.x = Math.random() * W; }
    if (m.x < -10) m.x = W + 10; else if (m.x > W + 10) m.x = -10;
  }
}

function stepRipples(dt) {
  for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    ripples[i].age += dt;
    if (ripples[i].age >= ripples[i].life) ripples.splice(i, 1);
  }
  ambientRipple -= dt;
  if (ambientRipple <= 0) {
    ambientRipple = 1.6 + Math.random() * 2.4;
    const a = Math.random() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.8;
    ripples.push({ u: Math.cos(a) * r, v: Math.sin(a) * r, age: 0, life: 2.4, maxR: Rb * 0.22, amp: 0.3 });
  }
  moveRipple -= dt;
  for (const o of oil) {
    o.u += o.vx * dt * (1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.6 + o.ph));
    o.v += o.vy * dt;
    const d = Math.hypot(o.u, o.v);
    if (d > 0.88) {
      o.vx = -(o.u / d) * Math.abs(o.vx || 0.003);
      o.vy = -(o.v / d) * Math.abs(o.vy || 0.003);
    }
  }
}

function poke(x, y, strong) {
  if (reduced) return;
  const u = (x - (cx + ox)) / Rb, v = (y - (cy + oy + by)) / (Rb * k);
  if (u * u + v * v < 0.9) {
    if (strong) {
      ripples.push({ u, v, age: 0, life: 3, maxR: Rb * 0.6, amp: 0.6 });
      ripples.push({ u, v, age: -0.25, life: 3, maxR: Rb * 0.5, amp: 0.4 });
    } else if (moveRipple <= 0 && Math.hypot(ptr.vx, ptr.vy) > 120) {
      moveRipple = 0.16;
      ripples.push({ u, v, age: 0, life: 2, maxR: Rb * 0.2, amp: 0.25 });
    }
  }
  if (strong) {
    const sc = R / 300;
    for (const p of steam) {
      const dx = p.x - x, dy = p.y - y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 0.001, inf = R * 1.0;
      if (d < inf) { const w = 1 - d / inf; p.vx += (dx / d) * 280 * sc * w; p.vy += (dy / d) * 180 * sc * w; }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) spawnSteam();
  }
}

function step(dt) {
  if (!reduced) time += dt;
  updatePointer(dt);
  geometry();
  flick = reduced ? 1 : 1 + 0.04 * Math.sin(time * 6.3) * Math.sin(time * 2.1) + 0.025 * Math.sin(time * 11.7 + 1);
  if (dt > 0) { stepSteam(dt); stepMotes(dt); stepRipples(dt); }
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function drawBackground() {
  let g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#040302'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#0b0705'); g.addColorStop(1, '#060403');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const cool = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.08, H * 0.04, 0, W * 0.08, H * 0.04, Math.max(W, H) * 0.65);
  cool.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(46,66,98,0.13)'); cool.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(46,66,98,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = cool; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const gx = cx + (light.x - cx) * 0.15, gy = cy - R * 0.5;
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, R * 2.6);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,145,60,${0.26 * flick})`);
  g.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(200,85,28,${0.12 * flick})`);
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200,85,28,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const hy = cy - R * 0.02;
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, hy, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(60,34,18,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.15, 'rgba(48,27,14,0.55)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(14,8,5,0.9)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, hy, W, H - hy);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, hy - 2, 0, hy + 4);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,170,90,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255,170,90,${0.05 * flick})`); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,170,90,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, hy - 2, W, 6);
}

function bowlBody() {
  const fx = R * 0.42, fy = fx * k;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-R, 0);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(-R * 0.99, D * 0.5, -R * 0.64, D * 0.96, -fx, D);
  ctx.ellipse(0, D, fx, fy, 0, PI, 0, true);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(R * 0.64, D * 0.96, R * 0.99, D * 0.5, R, 0);
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, 0, PI, false);
  ctx.closePath();
}
const bodyW = (y) => R - (R - R * 0.42) * Math.pow(clamp(y / D, 0, 1), 2.1);

function drawBowl() {
  const lx = clamp(light.x - (cx + ox), -R * 1.1, R * 1.1);
  let g;

  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(0, D); ctx.scale(1, 0.3);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, R * 1.9);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,150,70,${0.24 * flick})`);
  g.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(200,90,30,${0.08 * flick})`);
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200,90,30,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, R * 1.9, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(0, D + ry * 0.1); ctx.scale(1, k * 0.9);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.2, 0, 0, R * 0.8);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, R * 0.8, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.save();
  bowlBody(); ctx.clip();
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-R, 0, R, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#07090b'); g.addColorStop(0.3, '#151b21'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#10151a');
  g.addColorStop(0.85, '#0a0d10'); g.addColorStop(1, '#040506');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-R - 2, -2, 2 * R + 4, D + ry + 10);

  // vermilion band with gold lines
  const b1 = R * 0.10, b2 = R * 0.19;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, b1, R * 1.01, ry, 0, 0, PI, false);
  ctx.ellipse(0, b2, R * 0.99, ry * 0.99, 0, PI, 0, true);
  ctx.closePath();
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-R, 0, R, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#3a0c07'); g.addColorStop(0.3, '#8c2716'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#6d1d10'); g.addColorStop(1, '#260805');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,182,100,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8 * q;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, b1, R * 1.01, ry, 0, 0, PI, false); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, b2, R * 0.99, ry * 0.99, 0, 0, PI, false); ctx.stroke();

  // subtle wave pattern
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,215,230,0.06)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8 * q;
  for (let row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
    const yy = R * 0.30 + row * R * 0.10, wy = bodyW(yy), off = (row % 2) * 0.08;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let ph = -1.45 + off; ph <= 1.45; ph += 0.16) {
      const cph = Math.cos(ph), x = wy * Math.sin(ph), y = yy + wy * k * cph, rad = R * 0.06;
      ctx.moveTo(x - rad * cph - 0.01, y);
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad * cph + 0.01, rad, 0, PI, TAU);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ambient shading + warm bounce
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, D + ry * 0.5);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(140,70,25,0.20)'); g.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.addColorStop(0.85, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,55,20,0.25)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-R - 2, -2, 2 * R + 4, D + ry + 10);

  // specular streak following the light
  const sx = clamp(lx, -R * 0.85, R * 0.85);
  const yTop = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (sx / R) * (sx / R))) * ry + R * 0.03;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  for (const [w, a] of [[0.20, 0.035], [0.10, 0.05], [0.04, 0.09], [0.014, 0.16]]) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,228,196,${a})`; ctx.lineWidth = w * R;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, yTop); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx * 1.04, D * 0.55, sx * 0.72, D * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // rim
  ell(0, 0, R, ry);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-R, 0, R, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#12171c'); g.addColorStop(0.3, '#2b333b'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#1d242a'); g.addColorStop(1, '#0b0e11');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(lx - R * 0.5, 0, lx + R * 0.5, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,225,190,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,232,200,0.75)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,225,190,0)');
  ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 * q;
  ell(0, 0, R - 0.8 * q, ry - 0.8 * q); ctx.stroke();

  // inner wall
  ell(0, 0, R * 0.955, ry * 0.955);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ry, 0, ry);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#2e2016'); g.addColorStop(0.2, '#a67c4e'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#8b6541'); g.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a10');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,170,0.28)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1 * q; ctx.stroke();
}

function drawSoup() {
  ctx.save();
  ell(0, 0, R * 0.945, ry * 0.945); ctx.clip();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(0, by); ctx.scale(1, k);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, Rb, 0, TAU); ctx.clip();

  const lu = clamp((light.x - cx - ox) / R, -1, 1);
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(lu * 0.25 * Rb, -0.25 * Rb, 0, 0, 0, Rb);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#e0a650'); g.addColorStop(0.45, '#b06d2b'); g.addColorStop(0.8, '#753a17'); g.addColorStop(1, '#42200c');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-Rb, -Rb, 2 * Rb, 2 * Rb);

  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a = time * (0.05 + i * 0.017) + i * 1.9;
    const px = Math.cos(a * 1.3 + i) * 0.5 * Rb, py = Math.sin(a + i * 2) * 0.5 * Rb, r = Rb * (0.42 + 0.06 * (i % 3));
    const dark = i % 2;
    const gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, r);
    gg.addColorStop(0, dark ? 'rgba(50,20,6,0.35)' : 'rgba(255,190,90,0.28)');
    gg.addColorStop(1, dark ? 'rgba(50,20,6,0)' : 'rgba(255,190,90,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg; ctx.fillRect(-Rb, -Rb, 2 * Rb, 2 * Rb);
  }

  // oil droplets
  for (const o of oil) {
    const x = o.u * Rb, y = o.v * Rb, r = o.s * Rb;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = o.chili ? 'rgba(206,64,22,0.55)' : 'rgba(255,212,120,0.20)'; ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8 * q;
    ctx.strokeStyle = o.chili ? 'rgba(255,150,70,0.55)' : 'rgba(255,236,180,0.38)'; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - r * 0.32, y - r * 0.36, r * 0.28, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,250,235,0.55)'; ctx.fill();
  }

  // ripples
  for (const r of ripples) {
    if (r.age < 0) continue;
    const f = r.age / r.life, rad = r.maxR * Math.sqrt(f) + 1, a = (1 - f) * (1 - f) * r.amp;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4 * q * (1 - f * 0.5);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,228,170,${a})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.u * Rb, r.v * Rb, rad, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(50,20,5,${a * 0.7})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.u * Rb, r.v * Rb, rad + 1.6 * q, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,228,170,${a * 0.5})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.u * Rb, r.v * Rb, rad * 0.68, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // edge darkening + meniscus
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, Rb * 0.68, 0, 0, Rb);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(20,8,2,0)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,8,2,0.55)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-Rb, -Rb, 2 * Rb, 2 * Rb);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,120,0.2)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2 * q;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, Rb - q, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();

  // light reflection on the surface
  const gu = clamp(lu * 0.6, -0.65, 0.65) * Rb, gv = -0.42 * Rb;
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(gu, gv, 0, gu, gv, Rb * 0.5);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,236,190,0.28)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,236,190,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-Rb, -Rb, 2 * Rb, 2 * Rb);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(gu, gv); ctx.scale(1.8, 0.6);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, Rb * 0.14);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,250,235,0.42)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,250,235,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, Rb * 0.14, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawNori() {
  const a = S(0.24, -0.70, 0), b = S(0.80, -0.36, 0);
  const hN = R * 0.50, lean = R * 0.06, n = 8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1]);
  for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
    const t = i / n;
    ctx.lineTo(lerp(a[0], b[0], t) + lean + noriTop[i] * R * 0.3, lerp(a[1], b[1], t) - hN * (1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 9 + 1) + noriTop[i]));
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,8,2,0.4)'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.clip();
  const topY = Math.min(a[1], b[1]) - hN * 1.1, botY = Math.max(a[1], b[1]);
  let g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, topY, 0, botY);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#2b4432'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#15251a'); g.addColorStop(0.9, '#0a120c'); g.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a0c');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(a[0] - R * 0.2, topY, b[0] - a[0] + R * 0.5, botY - topY + 4);
  const f = clamp((light.x - cx) / R * 0.5 + 0.5, 0, 1);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(a[0], 0, b[0] + lean, 0);
  g.addColorStop(clamp(f - 0.3, 0, 1), 'rgba(170,230,190,0)');
  g.addColorStop(f, 'rgba(170,230,190,0.16)');
  g.addColorStop(clamp(f + 0.3, 0, 1), 'rgba(170,230,190,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(a[0] - R * 0.2, topY, b[0] - a[0] + R * 0.5, botY - topY + 4);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(159,208,168,0.07)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.7 * q;
  for (const fb of noriFibers) {
    const x0 = lerp(a[0], b[0], fb[0]), y0 = lerp(a[1], b[1], fb[0]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x0 + lean + fb[1] * R, y0 - hN * 1.05); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,210,170,0.28)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1 * q;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const t = i / n;
    const x = lerp(a[0], b[0], t) + lean + noriTop[i] * R * 0.3, y = lerp(a[1], b[1], t) - hN * (1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 9 + 1) + noriTop[i]);
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,210,140,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); ctx.stroke();
}

function slab(u, v, z, w, h, th, ang, top0, top1, side, stripe) {
  const p = S(u, v, z), x = p[0], y = p[1], r = Math.min(w, h) * 0.16;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(28,10,2,0.5)'; flatRect(x, y + th + q * 1.2, w * 1.06, h * 1.08, ang, r); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = side;
  for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { flatRect(x, y + th * i / 4, w, h, ang, r); ctx.fill(); }
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y - h * k * 0.5, 0, y + h * k * 0.5);
  g.addColorStop(0, top0); g.addColorStop(1, top1);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; flatRect(x, y, w, h, ang, r); ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  flatRect(x, y, w, h, ang, r); ctx.clip();
  ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.scale(1, k); ctx.rotate(ang);
  stripe(w, h);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,230,170,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1 * q;
  flatRect(x, y, w, h, ang, r); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawTofuAndMenma() {
  const menmaStripe = (w, h) => {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(110,70,20,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = w * 0.02;
    for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i * w * 0.11, -h / 2); ctx.lineTo(i * w * 0.11, h / 2); ctx.stroke(); }
  };
  slab(-0.40, -0.52, 0, R * 0.26, R * 0.08, R * 0.02, 0.9, '#dcb56c', '#b98e46', '#8f6a2c', menmaStripe);
  slab(-0.28, -0.62, 0, R * 0.26, R * 0.08, R * 0.02, 0.35, '#e0ba72', '#bd9249', '#8f6a2c', menmaStripe);
  slab(-0.12, -0.70, 0, R * 0.24, R * 0.08, R * 0.02, -0.25, '#d8b068', '#b58a42', '#8f6a2c', menmaStripe);

  const tofuStripe = (w, h) => {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(96,44,10,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = w * 0.05;
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i * w * 0.22 - h * 0.5, -h * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(i * w * 0.22 + h * 0.5, h * 0.5); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,236,190,0.22)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-w * 0.15, -h * 0.18, w * 0.28, h * 0.12, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  };
  slab(-0.68, -0.20, 0, R * 0.28, R * 0.30, R * 0.055, 0.35, '#e6ad57', '#c17f33', '#6b3c14', tofuStripe);
  slab(-0.62, -0.30, 0.055, R * 0.26, R * 0.28, R * 0.05, -0.25, '#eab35e', '#c68537', '#6b3c14', tofuStripe);
}

function drawNoodles() {
  const breathe = 1 + 0.025 * Math.sin(time * 1.2);
  for (let s = 0; s < NS; s++) {
    const st = strands[s], X = PX[s], Y = PY[s], Z = PZ[s], V = PV[s];
    for (let i = 0; i <= NP; i++) {
      const t = i / NP, th = st.th0 + st.dir * t * st.turns * TAU;
      const rho = lerp(st.r0, st.r1, t) + 0.07 * Math.sin(t * 6.5 + st.ph);
      const wob = st.wa * Math.sin(t * st.wf + st.ph + time * 0.9);
      const c = Math.cos(th), sn = Math.sin(th);
      const u = 0.02 + (rho * 1.06 + wob) * c, v = -0.03 + (rho * 0.96 + wob) * sn;
      const d = Math.min(1, Math.hypot((u - 0.02) / 1.06, (v + 0.03) / 0.96) / 0.72);
      const z = (0.24 * (1 - d * d) * st.hy + 0.018 * Math.sin(t * 9 + st.ph * 2) + st.zoff) * breathe;
      X[i] = u * Rb; Y[i] = by + v * Rb * k - z * R; Z[i] = z; V[i] = v;
    }
  }
  for (const ch of chunks) {
    const Z = PZ[ch.s], V = PV[ch.s], i0 = ch.c * CL;
    let sz = 0, sv = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j <= CL; j++) { sz += Z[i0 + j]; sv += V[i0 + j]; }
    ch.z = sz / (CL + 1);
    ch.key = ch.z + (sv / (CL + 1)) * 0.35;
  }
  chunks.sort((a, b) => a.key - b.key);
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  for (const ch of chunks) {
    const st = strands[ch.s], X = PX[ch.s], Y = PY[ch.s], i0 = ch.c * CL;
    const zt = clamp(ch.z / 0.2, 0, 1), w = st.w * q;
    const cr = Math.round(lerp(170, 246, zt) + st.tone), cg = Math.round(lerp(112, 214, zt) + st.tone), cb = Math.round(lerp(44, 140, zt) + st.tone * 0.6);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X[i0], Y[i0]);
    for (let j = 1; j <= CL; j++) ctx.lineTo(X[i0 + j], Y[i0 + j]);
    ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(70,34,8,${0.55 + 0.25 * (1 - zt)})`; ctx.lineWidth = w + 1.6 * q; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${cr},${cg},${cb})`; ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.stroke();
    if (zt > 0.2) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X[i0] - 0.3 * q, Y[i0] - 0.7 * q);
      for (let j = 1; j <= CL; j++) ctx.lineTo(X[i0 + j] - 0.3 * q, Y[i0 + j] - 0.7 * q);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,246,214,${0.12 + 0.4 * zt})`; ctx.lineWidth = w * 0.32; ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawBokChoy() {
  const base = S(-0.50, 0.42, 0.02);
  const leaves = [
    { a: -2.45, l: 0.22 }, { a: -0.70, l: 0.22 }, { a: -1.6, l: 0.25 }, { a: -2.95, l: 0.2 }, { a: -0.2, l: 0.2 }
  ];
  for (const lf of leaves) {
    const dx = Math.cos(lf.a), dy = Math.sin(lf.a) * (Math.abs(lf.a + 1.6) < 0.5 ? 1 : 0.7), L = lf.l * R;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,10,2,0.4)'; ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.05;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(base[0], base[1] + q * 2); ctx.lineTo(base[0] + dx * L * 0.6, base[1] + dy * L * 0.6 + q * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#dfe9b4'; ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.042;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(base[0], base[1]); ctx.lineTo(base[0] + dx * L * 0.6, base[1] + dy * L * 0.6); ctx.stroke();
    const bx = base[0] + dx * L * 0.98, byy = base[1] + dy * L * 0.98, rx = R * 0.12, rey = R * 0.07;
    const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bx, byy); ctx.rotate(ang);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-rx, 0, rx, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#8fcb5a'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#4d9a3b'); g.addColorStop(1, '#2a6f30');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx, rey, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,60,20,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1 * q; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(217,239,168,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4 * q;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-rx * 0.9, 0); ctx.lineTo(rx * 0.85, 0); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,220,0.16)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-rx * 0.1, -rey * 0.4, rx * 0.5, rey * 0.22, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function shiitake(u, v, rot, sc) {
  const p = S(u, v, 0.035), x = p[0], y = p[1], rx = R * 0.15 * sc, rey = R * 0.11 * sc;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(25,10,3,0.45)'; ell(x, y + rey * 0.4, rx * 1.08, rey); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b160a'; ell(x, y + rey * 0.28, rx, rey); ctx.fill();
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - rx * 0.25, y - rey * 0.35, rx * 0.05, x, y, rx * 1.05);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#b47a45'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#6d3f1e'); g.addColorStop(1, '#2d170b');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ell(x, y, rx, rey); ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  ell(x, y, rx, rey); ctx.clip();
  ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.scale(1, rey / rx); ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(238,214,170,0.85)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a = i * TAU / 5, len = rx * 0.92, nx = -Math.sin(a), ny = Math.cos(a);
    ctx.lineWidth = rx * 0.09;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    for (let j = 1; j <= 4; j++) {
      const t = j / 4, off = Math.sin(j * 2.1 + i * 1.7) * rx * 0.05;
      ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * len * t + nx * off, Math.sin(a) * len * t + ny * off);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(230,200,150,0.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = rx * 0.14;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, rx * 0.95, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,235,200,0.2)'; ell(x - rx * 0.3, y - rey * 0.45, rx * 0.3, rey * 0.14, -0.3); ctx.fill();
}

function drawCorn() {
  for (const c of corn) {
    const p = S(c.u, c.v, 0.012), x = p[0], y = p[1], r = R * 0.026;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,12,3,0.4)'; ell(x, y + r * 0.5, r, r * 0.8); ctx.fill();
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - r * 0.3, y - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, x, y, r * 1.1);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#fff0a0'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#f0b820'); g.addColorStop(1, '#c88510');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ell(x, y, r, r * 0.85, c.a); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawSprinkles() {
  for (const s of sesame) {
    const zm = zMound(s.u, s.v), p = S(s.u, s.v, zm > 0.02 ? zm + 0.03 : 0.004);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1e2c0'; ell(p[0], p[1], R * 0.010, R * 0.006, s.a); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(155,125,82,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.5 * q; ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const s of scallions) {
    const zm = zMound(s.u, s.v), p = S(s.u, s.v, zm > 0.02 ? zm + 0.025 : 0.004), x = p[0], y = p[1], r = s.s * R;
    if (s.ring) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,50,10,0.35)'; ell(x, y + r * k * 0.6, r, r * k * 1.1); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4f8f35'; ell(x, y, r, r * k * 1.25); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#98cc5e'; ell(x, y, r * 0.8, r * k * 1.0); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8a0'; ell(x, y, r * 0.5, r * k * 0.62); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,70,25,0.75)'; ell(x, y, r * 0.28, r * k * 0.36); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,50,10,0.35)'; ell(x, y + r * 0.2, r * 1.2, r * 0.5, s.a); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4f8f35'; ell(x, y, r * 1.2, r * 0.46, s.a); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd166'; ell(x, y - 0.4 * q, r * 1.0, r * 0.3, s.a); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawItems() {
  drawNori();
  drawTofuAndMenma();
  drawNoodles();
  drawBokChoy();
  shiitake(0.55, 0.30, 0.3, 1.0);

function drawBloom() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, by - R * 0.1, 0, 0, by - R * 0.1, R * 0.95);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,190,110,${0.10 * flick})`); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,190,110,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-R * 1.2, -R * 1.5, R * 2.4, R * 2.6);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSteam() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  const lx = light.x, ly = light.y, s2 = 2 * (R * 1.2) * (R * 1.2);
  for (const p of steam) {
    const f = p.age / p.life;
    const fade = smooth(0, 0.15, f) * (1 - smooth(0.35, 1, f));
    const dx = p.x - lx, dy = p.y - ly;
    const a = p.a * fade * (0.75 + 0.5 * Math.exp(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / s2));
    if (a < 0.003) continue;
    const s = lerp(p.s0, p.s1, Math.sqrt(f)), c = Math.cos(p.rot) * dpr, sn = Math.sin(p.rot) * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(c, sn, -sn, c, p.x * dpr, p.y * dpr);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.drawImage(puffs[p.img], -s / 2, -s / 2, s, s);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}

function drawMotes() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  const gx = cx, gy = cy - R * 0.4, s2 = 2 * (R * 1.6) * (R * 1.6);
  for (const m of motes) {
    const dx = m.x - gx, dy = m.y - gy;
    const near = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.exp(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / s2);
    const tw = reduced ? 0.7 : 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * m.tw + m.ph);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 * near * (0.25 + 0.75 * tw);
    const s = 5 * m.s;
    ctx.drawImage(glowSprite, m.x - s, m.y - s, s * 2, s * 2);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPost() {
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.55, Math.min(W, H) * 0.25, W / 2, H * 0.55, Math.hypot(W, H) * 0.6);
  vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.78)');
  ctx.fillStyle = vg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen'; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.03;
  const gx = reduced ? 0 : (Math.random() * 180) | 0, gy = reduced ? 0 : (Math.random() * 180) | 0;
  ctx.translate(-gx, -gy);
  ctx.fillStyle = grainPattern; ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, W, H);
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  drawBackground();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx + ox, cy + oy);
  drawBowl();
  drawSoup();
  drawItems();
  drawBloom();
  ctx.restore();
  drawSteam();
  drawMotes();
  drawPost();
}

/* ---------- loop & input ---------- */
let raf = 0, last = 0, staticQueued = false;
function frame(dt) { step(dt); draw(); }
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  frame(dt);
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function start() { if (raf) return; last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
function stop() { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
function queueStatic() {
  if (staticQueued) return;
  staticQueued = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { staticQueued = false; frame(0); });
}

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
  ptr.x = e.clientX; ptr.y = e.clientY; ptr.last = performance.now();
  if (reduced) { ptr.live = true; queueStatic(); return; }
  poke(e.clientX, e.clientY, false);
}, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  ptr.x = e.clientX; ptr.y = e.clientY; ptr.last = performance.now();
  if (reduced) { queueStatic(); return; }
  poke(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
}, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  resize();
  if (reduced) queueStatic();
});

const onMotionChange = (e) => {
  reduced = e.matches;
  if (reduced) { stop(); time = 12; steam.length = 0; prefillSteam(); frame(0); }
  else { start(); }
};
if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', onMotionChange); else mq.addListener(onMotionChange);

if (reduced) time = 12;
resize();
if (reduced) frame(0); else start();
})();
</script>

I wrote `index.html` in the working directory, but I couldn't open it in a browser here, so it's untested and any tuning is still to do. It's one file with inline CSS and JS, no external assets and no generated images. Everything is drawn procedurally on a canvas.

- **Scene:** one dark lacquered bowl with a vermilion and gold band, sitting in a warm, flickering glow. The bowl holds amber miso broth with drifting oil and chili droplets, curly noodles, fried tofu, bamboo shoots, shiitake, bok choy, corn, scallions, sesame and a standing nori sheet. The broth's colour swirls slowly, ripples fall now and then, and the noodles move gently. Steam curls up from the bowl and faint dust motes drift through the light.
- **Mouse:**
  - A warm light follows the cursor and moves the highlights on the bowl, broth and rim.
  - Moving the cursor tilts the view slightly.
  - The cursor pushes the steam and dust around, and moving over the broth makes small ripples.
  - Clicking or tapping makes a big ripple and a puff of steam.
  - With no input for a few seconds, the light drifts on its own.
- **Reduced motion:** with `prefers-reduced-motion`, it draws one still frame with steam already in place and no animation loop. Moving the cursor still shifts the light, and the setting is picked up live if it changes.
- **Responsive:** the bowl scales to fit any viewport and the canvas is sharp on high-DPI screens.
